roles.name: Guest
roles.description: The person staying at the property; books, checks in/out, and pays.

roles.name: Front desk agent
roles.description: Handles check-in/out, folio charges, and in-person reservation changes.

roles.name: Housekeeper
roles.description: Cleans and turns over rooms between stays and updates room status.

provenance.notes: No dedicated housekeeping role found in either inspected implementation; reasoned from industry practice.

roles.name: Revenue manager
roles.description: Owns rates, restrictions, and channel distribution to maximize occupancy and revenue.

roles.name: Property manager
roles.description: Owns property setup, room types, staffing, and cross-property reporting.

roles.name: Owner
roles.description: Owns the property/business; sets strategic direction and reviews overall performance, typically not involved in day-to-day operations.
responsibilities: Review consolidated financial and occupancy performance
Delegate day-to-day operations to a general manager

provenance.notes: No implementation models an 'owner' account distinct from an administrator; inferred from common hotel-industry organizational structure (an owner/investor role separate from operational management).

roles.name: General manager
roles.description: Runs the property day-to-day: oversees all departments, staffing, and the night audit/close process.
responsibilities: Oversee front desk, housekeeping, and maintenance operations
Review the night audit and resolve exceptions

provenance.notes: No implementation models a distinct 'general manager' account (both inspected PMSs use a flat administrator/staff split); inferred from standard hotel organizational structure.

roles.name: Reservations agent
roles.description: Takes bookings by phone, email, or a call center — as distinct from the front desk agent who handles in-person arrivals — and manages group/block reservations.
responsibilities: Quote rates and availability to prospective guests

provenance.notes: QloApps and Frappe Hospitality both model a single staff/administrator role for all reservation handling, with no separate reservations-office account; a distinct reservations agent is common hotel-industry staffing practice (call center or reservations office, distinct from front-desk arrivals staff) but not evidenced in either implementation's data model.

roles.name: Maintenance / engineering
roles.description: Repairs and maintains rooms and property infrastructure; takes rooms out of order and returns them to service.
responsibilities: Diagnose and repair reported room issues
Mark rooms out of order and back in service

provenance.notes: QloApps models a room 'temporarily inactive' status but no dedicated maintenance role or work-order entity; a separate maintenance/engineering role is common hotel-industry staffing practice, reasoned rather than directly evidenced.

roles.name: Night auditor
roles.description: Runs the end-of-day close: posts room charges, reconciles payments, and rolls the business date forward, typically on the overnight shift.
responsibilities: Post the day's room charges to open folios
Roll the business date forward and resolve no-shows

provenance.notes: Not present as a distinct account/role in either inspected implementation (neither has a night-audit module at all); 'night auditor' is a standard, named job title in hotel operations per the existing secondary source. Smaller properties often have the front desk agent on the night shift perform this role instead of a dedicated hire.
